milestone_terms.title: VerdictGraph v2 production settlement
milestone_terms.objective: Demonstrate that the replacement VerdictGraph v2 deployment is live on Bradbury and independently verifiable through the acceptance-authority, sponsor-bound milestone, hash-pinned evidence, GenLayer review, and deterministic Vault settlement flow.
milestone_terms.success_criterion: The sponsor creates this milestone from the finalized verdictgraph-v2 trust root; the owner funds exactly 0.010 GEN; the beneficiary posts exactly 0.002 GEN; the beneficiary submits an approved-origin HTTPS evidence artifact whose bytes match its declared SHA-256; GenLayer finalizes PASS, FAIL, or UNDETERMINED; and the public Proof Pack shows the finalized decision, evidence digest, and terminal Vault state.

capabilities: constructor-bound acceptance authority and write-once accepted-project trust roots
immutable milestone terms inherited from the accepted baseline
hash-pinned HTTPS evidence with authority-registered origins and UTF-8 verification
independent GenLayer review with PASS, FAIL, and UNDETERMINED outcomes
finality-only settlement messages to a deterministic exact-amount Vault

interpretation: This artifact identifies the accepted v2 trust root and the independently verifiable GenLayer Bradbury milestone release. The on-chain Registry, GenLayer validator review, and deterministic Vault remain the authorities for lifecycle state, decision, and settlement; this document does not replace those finalized records.
